items.title: Making decisions
items.prompt: Compare two of these situations. Why might the people need to decide quickly? How difficult might the decision be?
points: a surgeon in an operating theatre
a trader on a busy stock-exchange floor
a family choosing a new home

items.title: Working together
items.prompt: Compare two of these situations. How are the people working together, and what might be challenging for them?
points: a pit crew during a motor race
colleagues brainstorming on a video call

items.title: Ways of learning
items.prompt: Compare two of these situations. Why might the people have chosen to learn in this way, and how effective might it be?
points: an adult at an evening class
a teenager learning from online videos
an apprentice working beside an expert

items.title: Under pressure
items.prompt: Compare two of these situations. What kind of pressure are the people under, and how might they deal with it?
points: a chef during a busy service
a student the night before a final exam
a manager presenting bad results to the board

items.title: Celebrations
items.prompt: Compare two of these situations. Why might people celebrate in these ways, and how memorable might the occasions be?
points: a team dinner after winning a big contract
a small family birthday at home

items.title: Attracting young talent
items.prompt: Here are some things a company could do to attract young employees. Talk about how effective each might be, then decide which two would make the biggest difference.

items.title: A more liveable city
items.prompt: Here are some ways a city could become a better place to live. Talk about the benefits of each, then decide which one should be the priority.

items.title: A more productive team
items.prompt: Here are some ways to make a team more productive. Talk about how each might help, then decide which would work best in your own workplace.

items.title: Profit or people?
items.prompt: Is it ever right for a company to put profit before its employees' well-being? Why or why not?

items.title: AI and language learning
items.prompt: Will artificial intelligence make learning foreign languages unnecessary? Give reasons and examples.

items.title: Judging companies
items.prompt: Should companies be judged on their social impact as much as on their profits?

items.title: Trusting the data
items.prompt: Do organisations rely too much on data when making decisions? What gets lost?
